description: Use this when someone asks when the cherry blossoms, hydrangeas, ginkgo or maple leaves are out around Kamakura, or whether a date falls in a bloom window. Returns the most likely date, the likely range, the earliest and latest of recent years, the 1991 to 2020 average, the observed date for past years, where a given date falls, and how the dates are modelled from Japan Meteorological Agency records. Shows a season calendar card. Examples: "When do the hydrangeas bloom in Kamakura?" / "Will the cherry blossoms be out in Kamakura on April 2?"

date.description: A travel date as YYYY-MM-DD, to see where it falls in each window.

flower.description: cherry, hydrangea, autumn (ginkgo and maple), ginkgo or maple; sakura, ajisai and momiji work too. Omit for all five events.

year.description: Year. Default: the next season to come.

name: bloom_forecast

link.description: Page on kamakura.info for this answer.

title: Kamakura bloom forecast
